title: VocabBoost word sense disambiguation
subtitle: Sense-annotated sentences for training a small subtitle sense picker
description:
Training data for VocabBoost, a Chrome extension that picks which dictionary sense a subtitle line means, offline and with no API key.

Files:

- semcor.jsonl - SemCor, the human sense annotations bundled with NLTK, converted to one row per annotated word.
- teacher-labels.jsonl - 8,431 subtitle lines labelled by a panel of five model families, with the number that agreed on each. Hand-checking 100 of them put the unanimous labels at 58/60.
- working.jsonl - 149 subtitle lines labelled by hand. The test set.

Every row has the line, the target word, its candidate senses as WordNet 3.0 keys, and which one is right.

Sources: sentences from OpenSubtitles, senses from WordNet 3.0, panel labels from commercial models via fal.ai. Not public domain - see the repository for what may be reused.

Code and method: https://github.com/farukkavlak/vocabboost
